g.text: Validate data types (integers for shares, threshold, timeout)
Juju Machine Deployment AND systemctl available?
Vault stuck in Juju OR systemctl service down?
Identify Leader Unit and public addresses
Fetch Vault CA Cert via Juju Secrets
Tunnel command via Pebble socket inside pod
Execute locally using host Vault CLI
Prompt user for manual GPG file paths
Prompt user for raw text unseal keys
Parse JSON for Token and Keys
Add Root Token as Juju one-time secret
All Units Unsealed AND Authorized AND
Run cleanup trap (remove temporary CA and empty creds dir)
